## 维护者速读
- 改了什么:动作协议文档里 `preflight`(参数对话框提交前的服务端预读)两处仍写着「规划中、尚未绘制」,改为已上线,并照台账写明控制台实际行为。
- 为什么改:读取端与 spec 均已落地,活性台账该行为 `live`;文档却告诉作者「声明了也看不到任何效果」,会让作者放弃一个已可用的键。
- 风险与回滚:仅文档散文两行,无代码、无发布面;回滚即还原这一个 commit。
- 先看:`content/docs/protocol/objectui/actions.mdx` 的 `preflight` 一节开头的提示框,以及类型清单里 `preflight` 那一行的注释。
- 两分钟验证:`git grep -n -i planned content/docs/protocol/objectui/actions.mdx` 应无输出;对照 `packages/spec/liveness/action.json` 的 `preflight` 行 note,文档未写超出它的行为。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

Fixes #32080

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — docs prose only: no authorable key, value or behaviour changes, so no published skill states anything this PR moves.

## What changes
`content/docs/protocol/objectui/actions.mdx`, two lines, nothing else:
- The `preflight` line of the action type listing: the comment no longer says "planned: not drawn yet"; it says the param dialog sends the read and shows it above the params before submit.
- The callout opening "Showing a server read before submit: `preflight`": "Planned … until that reader lands" is replaced by a "Live" callout that says what the console does, taken from the `preflight` row of `packages/spec/liveness/action.json` (status `live`, reader #31808, spec #31840) and nothing beyond it: the read is sent once every `${param.NAME}` hole in `read.url` has a value; the answer at `path` is drawn above the params, each `fields` row as the result dialog draws it; each `seed` applies only from the answer to the current URL; a seeded param is drawn read-only and submitted as shown; a refused, unbound or failed read leaves the seeds empty.

No other sentence on the page calls `preflight` planned (`git grep -n -i planned` on the file: no hits after the change).

Docs prose only: no test pins this text and no behaviour changes, so no test was added. No changeset: `content/docs/**` ships in no package's `files[]`, so this PR publishes nothing (label `skip-changeset`).
